# Memes

Images for the reviewer comment that `triage.yml` posts on a new pull request ([`reviewer_comment.py`](../scripts/reviewer_comment.py)). The comment links them from `main`, so a new image shows only after it is merged.

| Image | |
|---|---|
| `detective-blob.png` | ![detective blob](detective-blob.png) |
| `detective-hamster.png` | ![detective hamster](detective-hamster.png) |
| `reading.png` | ![reading](reading.png) |
| `scheming.png` | ![scheming](scheming.png) |
| `summoned.png` | ![summoned](summoned.png) |

Keep each image under 1 MB; `tests/test_repo_policy.py` fails on larger files.
